# gigahost_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up one account SSH key by name — for wiring keys created outside Terraform into `gigahost_server.ssh_keys` via `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference an SSH key created outside Terraform by name.
data "gigahost_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name = "laptop"
}

resource "gigahost_server" "web" {
  type     = "value"
  size     = "2c-4gb-40gb"
  os       = "debian-12"
  ssh_keys = [data.gigahost_ssh_key.laptop.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name as shown by `gigahost account ssh-keys list`.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Key ID for `gigahost_server.ssh_keys`.
- `public_key` (String)
